title: Winey Dense Venezuelan Mushrooms Bowl
description: A wine and earthy rich dish from Venezuela featuring wood ear mushrooms, crispy fermented dough and vibrant Korean brass bowl presentation.

ingredients.name: Long fermentation dough
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade cracker dough for the best results.

instructions: Break the long fermentation dough into small pieces and toast in the oven for 5 minutes or until crispy.
Sauté the sliced red onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add the wood ear mushrooms and sauté until slightly browned.
Add the white wine vinegar, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, garlic powder, and Korean chili flakes. Stir to combine.
Add the red wine and water, and bring to a simmer.
Add the beef or vegetable broth, if using.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the crispy fermented dough to the bowl and top with the mushroom mixture.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve in a Korean brass bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy the flavors of Venezuela.
Wine pairing suggestions: Malbec or Merlot.
This recipe makes 4 servings and can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
